levels.text: Teammates affected by Protective Gale can trigger healing gusts on successful evades, sharing your Second Wind cooldown.

name: Shared Breath
notes:
A shared gust originates at the evading teammate and heals that player and nearby teammates. These gusts share the same cooldown as your own Second Wind gusts and apply your other Second Wind orbs, including Lingering Breeze.

In game (hwp_rog_sw_shared_breath, built): teammates Protective Gale reaches can release the gust on their evades. Checked only that the rogue does not get it; a teammate needs a second player.
summary: Teammates affected by Protective Gale can also trigger Second Wind healing gusts when they successfully evade an attack.
